sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-08-v16-full/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks sheet1 row 8 and Internal Quality Checks sheet4 row 8: 'task_asks_for_a_real_working_product' / 'Real build work is required; a stub or trivial tweak can't earn the reward.'; column E annotation empty; no comment parts in the workbook)
evidence: Smallest submission satisfying the brief is a substantial from-scratch build, not a stub or CRUD screen: instruction.md:3 says 'there is no starter app to finish' and seed_data.json has snippets: []; ui.md:3 forbids textarea/input/contenteditable and CodeMirror/Monaco/Ace etc., requiring a self-written caret/selection/undo model with multi-caret, grapheme handling, find/replace, block indent, semantic colouring and idempotent Format (ui.md:5-15); behaviour.md:3-13 requires an isolated per-run preview with ordered console, line-numbered errors and unhandled rejections, last-good restore, a 5 s budget, Stop/supersede cancellation, SQLite revision history surviving restart (integration.md:9), stale-save refusal across tabs, live library refresh within ~5 s, and idempotent restore; security.md:3-5 adds a fetch-blocked sandbox and dynamic-code refusal. The grading enforces this: gates are all_pass (render needs a code editing area; constraints cw_custom_document_surface fails textarea/contenteditable/ready-made editor roots, cw_shared_saved_record requires server-backed readback after clearing all browser storage), so a static page, mock or localStorage-only app scores 0 via score.py:41-48. Functional has 43 binary criteria totalling weight 59 with floor 0.05 (scoring.toml:11), so even after the gates roughly 3 weight units of genuine editor/run/persistence behaviour are needed before polish/visual count. Counter-checks: a plausible broken app (div-rendered single-caret editor + iframe Run + SQLite save) passes gates and floor and would earn only partial reward (~0.2-0.3 by my estimate), which still requires real build work; a conforming alternative (canvas- or SVG-drawn editor, any routes/schema per policy.md:3) is explicitly allowed by the constraints gate, so it is not excluded. Runtime caveat (not a waiver, and not needed for this source-level row): raw-evidence-index.json states no configured judge run exists for v16 bytes; the v15 nop=0 / Oracle 1.0 results are on different brief/criteria bytes and are not cited as v16 measurements.
